title: Review-response medians in a small trial
method: Synthetic observations: before 2,4,6,8,10 hours; during 1,2,3,4,9 hours. Each median is the third sorted observation. Sample size is five per group; the comparison does not establish causality or productivity.
alt: Median initial review-response time is 6 hours before and 3 hours during a fictional five-request trial.
